reasoning: 21.10.1（SA13.1）規定 Auto-On Radio 設為 Off 時，ignition cycle 之後收音機不會自動開啟。驗證必須跨越 ignition cycle，故步驟明確包含關閉再開啟電門。前置條件刻意讓收音機在 ignition cycle 前處於開啟狀態，使 cycle 後的狀態變化可判定——若前後狀態相同，無法區分「設定生效」與「狀態未改變」。ER 以收音機的開關狀態與音訊輸出兩者判定，不使用不可觀察的內部狀態敘述。本筆與 SWE1-MEDIA-INT-015 及 INT-016 構成三個設定值的完整涵蓋（§7）。優先級：影響上電後的使用者體驗，訂 P1。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本筆為 Auto-On Radio 設為 Off 的情況，與另兩個設定值構成三向涵蓋

tcs.test_item:
The system shall prevent the radio from turning on automatically after an ignition cycle when Auto-On Radio is set to OFF.

(Auto-On Radio set to "Off")
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The radio in the vehicle has a power button and is not an ICS radio
2. Auto-On Radio is set to Off
3. Before the ignition is switched off, the radio is on
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Switch the ignition off and read the state of the HU
2. Switch the ignition on and wait until the HU has completed start-up
3. Read the state of the radio and listen to the audio output of the HU
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU is switched off
2. The HU has completed start-up
3. The radio is off and no audio is output from the HU speakers
